correctness.rationale: Log Nash objective is concave, and KKT scores G_j≤n with equality for funded projects are necessary and sufficient; every optimum has unique reported utility vector. Reviewed provided exact SymPy enumerator: all 329 anonymous profiles n=1..4 (7+28+84+210), certified optimizers via rational 1/24 lattice KKT and exact sqrt17 algebraic candidates, enumerated full optimal face vertices by exact linear solves and every unilateral ballot change. The program asserts 0,0,0,6 manipulated profiles, 12 changes and two gains. Independently reconstructed representative [B,AB,C,AC]: true p=(0,1/2,1/2), misreport AB→A has Nash q=(3/8,1/4,3/8), both satisfy exact G=[4,4,4], and true gain (5/8)/(1/2)=5/4. Analytical two-project rule reduces to singleton counts a,b and p=(a/(a+b),b/(a+b)). The complete finite census depends on careful inspected certificate, not a newly performed independent full rerun; full checker can be replayed with SymPy 1.14.
residual_risks: Independent replay checked one exact representative, not every 329 profile; full census conditional on source verifier coverage and KKT/face-vertex completeness reviewed in actual script.
